analyst.summary: Marksans Pharma makes generic and OTC pharmaceutical products for the UK, Europe, Australia/New Zealand and US markets, and just posted a strong accelerating quarter -- revenue up 53% and profit up 64% -- and recently completed a bolt-on acquisition in Germany to deepen its European presence. The growth is genuine, but it has come with rising debt and slower-turning inventory, so it is worth confirming this is durable, self-funding growth rather than working-capital-supported growth before getting more constructive. We rate it a Hold: real recent momentum, but with balance-sheet trends that deserve a closer look.
